title: reader config: auth.required=false with no users is 'dev mode' but not labeled at runtime
description: reader/src/config.rs AuthConfig::is_dev_mode() returns true when required=false and users is empty and credential_file is None. In lifecycle.rs this causes AUTHINFO PASS to accept any password. The reader config example sets 'required = false' with no users list. An operator who deploys with the example config as-is gets an open NNTP server that authenticates anyone. There is no warning logged at startup when dev mode is active on a non-loopback address. Maintenance consequence: operators who copy the example config into production get an open server with no visible indication in logs.
